Repository created and materialized from collector_predictor_template. elexon_market_index_prices implemented: half-hourly MID price and volume from 2016-09-12, settlement period encoded in series_id so the DATE-keyed schema is untouched. Licence confirmed: Elexon grants a worldwide, royalty-free, perpetual licence permitting automation and historical storage, subject to attribution. The API rejects windows wider than 7 days, so the history is walked in 7-day windows and each window body is one snapshot.
